title: GIFT: Reconciling Post-Training Objectives via Variational Finite-Temperature Gibbs Initialization
abstract: arXiv:2601.09233v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The prevailing post-training paradigm for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs)---Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL)-suffers from an intrinsic optimization mismatch: the rigid likelihood maximization in SFT induces distributional collapse, thereby exhausting the exploration space necessary for subsequent RL. Motivated by the Gibbs optimum of KL-regularized RL, we derive a token-level variational surrogate that makes the SFT target structurally compatible with the subsequent RL stage, and propose Gibbs Initialization with Finite Temperature (GIFT). Standard SFT emerges as a degenerate zero-temperature limit of this surrogate, while a finite temperature preserves structural diversity. Our experiments demonstrate that GIFT outperforms standard SFT and surpasses competitive baselines when utilized for RL initialization. Our code is available at https://github.com/zzy1127/GIFT.

translated_title: GIFT：通过变分有限温度Gibbs初始化调和后训练目标
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型（LRM）主流的后训练范式——先监督微调（SFT）后强化学习（RL）——存在固有的优化失配问题：SFT中刚性的似然最大化会导致分布坍缩，从而耗尽后续RL所必需的探索空间。受KL正则化RL的Gibbs最优解启发，我们推导出一个token级别的变分代理目标，使SFT目标在结构上与后续RL阶段兼容，并提出了有限温度Gibbs初始化（GIFT）。标准SFT是该代理目标的退化零温极限，而有限温度则能保留结构多样性。我们的实验表明，GIFT优于标准SFT，并在用作RL初始化时超越了具有竞争力的基线方法。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/zzy1127/GIFT 获取。
tldr: 该论文提出GIFT方法，通过token级变分代理目标引入有限温度Gibbs初始化，使SFT目标与后续RL阶段结构兼容，避免分布坍缩并保留探索空间，从而提升大型推理模型的后训练效果。
en_tdlr: GIFT proposes a token-level variational surrogate with finite-temperature Gibbs initialization to make SFT structurally compatible with subsequent RL, preventing distributional collapse and preserving exploration space for improved post-training of large reasoning models.
